value.rationale: Physical sensor movement is naturally along original graph edges. A universal exact sharp diameter in an infinite family and a sharp disconnected boundary at six vertices demonstrate a genuine mobility threshold not visible in the known optimum count or unrestricted move geometry. The polynomial slide-edge count gives a reusable exact benchmark.
